_doc: Public outdoor bench + practicing an instrument on it. furniture_public_bench is the furniture that makes a place a valid outdoor practice spot: it offers the ordinary rest commands and every command tagged instrument_practice_outdoor (givesJob comTags). Put it only in public outdoor rooms (riverside lawn, park lawn) - indoor benches (hospital waiting rooms...) use other furniture and never qualify. com_instrument_practice_outdoor is open to anyone; who actively schedules it is decided elsewhere - e.g. an organization's individual activity (doujin_GirlsBandCry faction.json: jp_individual_instrument_practice, facility.comTag instrument_practice_outdoor) finds every venue with such a bench (RecreationUtility.IndividualVenues). A passerby may join a practice as a listener (allowJoining; listener variant with a receiver).

list._comment_roles: The practicing doer pays the practice costs. A passerby may join as a listener (receiver variant) without practicing themselves.

zh-cn.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_begin: $doer.firstname$在长椅上坐下，取出乐器调好音，试着弹了几个音。
zh-cn.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_ongoing: $doer.firstname$专注地反复练习着还不顺手的段落。
zh-cn.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_after: $doer.firstname$练完这一段，放松了一下手指。
